title: Boston Gas Company files for review and approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy a 365-Day Firm Transportation Service Agreement with South Shore Hospital.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department of Telecommunications and Energy APPROVES he proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Judith F. Judson, Chairman; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating and Brian Paul Golden. (D.T.E. 06-GC-11)
